"""Request handlers."""

from app.services import users


def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user

"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))

import json

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import re
+from datetime import date
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MONTH_NUMBERS = {
+    "jan": 1,
+    "january": 1,
+    "feb": 2,
+    "february": 2,
+    "mar": 3,
+    "march": 3,
+    "apr": 4,
+    "april": 4,
+    "may": 5,
+    "jun": 6,
+    "june": 6,
+    "jul": 7,
+    "july": 7,
+    "aug": 8,
+    "august": 8,
+    "sep": 9,
+    "september": 9,
+    "oct": 10,
+    "october": 10,
+    "nov": 11,
+    "november": 11,
+    "dec": 12,
+    "december": 12,
+}
+
+_ISO_PATTERN = re.compile(r"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})")
+_DAY_MONTH_YEAR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"([0-9]{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) ([0-9]{4})")
+_MONTH_DAY_YEAR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z]+) ([0-9]{1,2}), ([0-9]{4})")
+_DAY_SLASH_MONTH_YEAR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{4})")
+
+
+def _make_date(year: str, month: int, day: str) -> date | None:
+    """Return a real calendar date, or None when the values are out of range."""
+    try:
+        return date(int(year), month, int(day))
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _parse_date(value: str) -> date | None:
+    """Parse one of the supported date forms, or return None."""
+    match = _ISO_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)
+    if match:
+        year, month, day = match.groups()
+        return _make_date(year, int(month), day)
+
+    match = _DAY_MONTH_YEAR_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)
+    if match:
+        day, month_name, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTH_NUMBERS.get(month_name.lower())
+        return _make_date(year, month, day) if month is not None else None
+
+    match = _MONTH_DAY_YEAR_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)
+    if match:
+        month_name, day, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTH_NUMBERS.get(month_name.lower())
+        return _make_date(year, month, day) if month is not None else None
+
+    match = _DAY_SLASH_MONTH_YEAR_PATTERN.fullmatch(value)
+    if match:
+        day, month, year = match.groups()
+        return _make_date(year, int(month), day)
+
+    return None
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_normalize_date(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("date") if isinstance(params, dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+    parsed = _parse_date(raw.strip())
+    if parsed is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid date"}
+    return 200, {"date": parsed.isoformat()}
